name: nisshi-stream-app
description: Starter for event streaming (1.0.1: creates its topic again when the broker comes back on empty storage): a Node service that creates its topic on a Nisshi broker (Kafka-compatible, nisshi.io), produces events and consumes them back, with a page to send events and watch them arrive. Deployed with deployment rules such as k8s-deploy, which run the broker and its storage.
